title: Prepare opportunity workflows before presenting them
head: Commit containing this receipt; published SHA is recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested feature stack on corrected F-08; keep all PRs unmerged.

source_review.comparison: A06/A07 unchanged at baseline; A11 differs by the already-reviewed F08 prompt revision. Task-relevant sections and live Q13 implementation inspected.

figma.visual: Backend API/provider only; no visible UI delta or screenshot claimed.

activation.requires: Configured composer, current shared workflow database, installed Q13 qualifier/dry runner, existing engine bundle. Fixed optional loader returns unavailable when absent; no static Q13 imports.

implementation: Additive prepared snapshot, attempt budget and revision history tables; canonical source ID, exact locked disabled flow/version, confirmed specification/evidence/goal rationale and journal.
Shared durable composer lease helper, singleton prepared processing, rolling daily budget, per-proposal retries, queue/page limits and abort/deadline ownership fencing.
Separate preparing/blocked/ready/stale/dismissed/accepted projection; CAS dismissal/retry, no legacy acceptance or feedback writes. Accepted storage is reserved for F10.

Actual optional Q13 adapter checks live bindings, goals, Authority, exact graph and sample provenance at preparation and every read. Readiness loss and prior publication withdraw approval eligibility.
Authenticated, no-store, bounded and strict API; public projection excludes raw captured sample outputs and credentials. No approve, publish, enable, live send or manual run path.

acceptance.check: Restart and duplicate processing retain one exact snapshot
acceptance.evidence: Persistent database reopen, concurrent workers, canonical replay, rollback-on-attachment-failure and immutable locked version tests.

acceptance.check: Dismissal during preparation never creates a new visible ready proposal
acceptance.evidence: Deferred composition and qualification tests, legacy dismissal, changed confirmation, timeouts, shutdown and storage failure fencing.

acceptance.check: Ready requires current source, readiness and required bindings
acceptance.evidence: Changed goal/version/bindings, absent quality, mismatched qualification and publication elsewhere tests; actual Q13 real-engine integration.

acceptance.check: Preview does not claim an effect occurred
acceptance.evidence: Only illustrative/sandbox provenance; simulated service markers, null real run ID, no live jobs/runs, no raw sample output in read/model requests.

acceptance.check: Background cost bounded and rollback additive
acceptance.evidence: Three attempts per rolling day across restart, two attempts per proposal, queue saturation, explicit retry and state history tests.

affected.skip: The optional actual-Q13 integration ran separately with its source overlay.

q13_integration.method: Temporary overlay of Q13 prepared-qualification.ts, prepared-dry-run.ts and its effect-capabilities.ts helper at the pinned commit; restored after test. No Q13 implementation committed.

verification.guards: Normal pre-commit EE, migrations, templates, package, related tests and TypeScript required; published outcome recorded in PR.

limitations: Default off and unavailable without Q13; integration is proven locally but the dependency is not merged into this feature branch.

Empty default synthetic fixture blocks model/context/tool steps requiring fixture values. Trusted integration may supply a fixture factory; HTTP cannot forge sample success. Unsupported graphs retain illustrative provenance and Q13 review requirements.
Custom confirmed job/outcome text adds an unverified constraint; structural validation does not prove every natural-language requirement.
Preparation may spend bounded model calls only when explicitly activated. No paid model calls, real credentials, live effects, activation or deployment were used for verification.
F10 acceptance/activation and dashboard presentation are not implemented by F09. Backend-only verification path is in the guide.
Parent F08 corrected head has green Docker/platform checks but full CI remains red after two different Chromium fixture setup/teardown failures; not treated as a feature verification pass.
rollback: Unset the flag and restart; preserve additive tables, journals, history and disabled workflows. No down-migration, deletion or replay.

findings.change: Shared durable opportunity owner, enforced in both entry/retry paths, lease claims and attachments. Old mixed queues resolve by earliest eligible retained request; setup-only blockers own no work.
Application-authored public blockers, including read-time sanitization of pre-upgrade error text. Provider and parse diagnostics remain in the linked journal.
Bind composition journal inside journal creation transaction before inference; retain link on failure, timeout, dismissal, shutdown and rollback, and archive it on retry.
Distinct workflow_missing and workflow_version_missing recovery blockers, separate from unavailable Q13 qualification.

review_corrections.additional_ci_fix: Reviewed-head CI passed 8090 tests, skipped 32 and failed the capability-reader inventory. Recorded the F09 daemon projection in the explicit reader allowlist and shared predicate documentation; it carries unavailable names to Q13 and adds no routing predicate.
review_corrections.publication: Same PR #766, remains stacked on brief/f-08. Final commit SHA and CI status are recorded in its description.
